02

Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
synthesis

Compare ODE/OD primary-amine shell conditions and optional late OD dilution

Compare ODE/OD primary-amine shell conditions and optional late OD dilution. For 3–4 nm cores in ODE/primary amine, precipitation begins after about seven monolayers following Cd addition. Added S/ODE initially redissolves particles; at more than eleven layers an entire sulfur aliquot no longer fully clears the solution. Replacing ODE by OD delays initial turbidity until at least eleven monolayers. Beginning at ten monolayers, modest OD dilution reduces dot concentration and improves size/shape uniformity. Combined with longer annealing, this produces the Table 2 row 3 spherical/faceted population; no complete per-layer dilution schedule is given. Missing fields: complete per-row protocol. This operation groups source-described alternatives for navigation, not a single physical charge containing all alternatives simultaneously.

02
synthesis

Start at the reported extreme dot dilution

Start at the reported extreme dot dilution. Extreme initial dilution abolishes turbidity but yields half-moon particles, polytypic structure and low QYs at all shell thicknesses. Missing fields: full precursor schedule. This operation groups source-described alternatives for navigation, not a single physical charge containing all alternatives simultaneously.

03
synthesis

Compare primary, secondary and no-added-amine preparations

Compare primary, secondary and no-added-amine preparations. The described typical shell reaction adds all primary oleylamine initially, while OA enters with each Cd aliquot. An illustrative fourteen-layer context compares 15 mmol amine with 6.5 mmol OA. The medium is approximately equal polar/nonpolar mass; this is not a complete formulation recipe. Dioctylamine suppresses precipitation but gives nonemissive octahedral particles with predominantly wurtzite phase. The proposed eight alternating polar facets and nonpolar overall shape are the authors’ interpretation, not an atomic-coordinate reconstruction. Removing added amine, while allowing residual core-bound primary amine, causes the earliest precipitation from three monolayers. Table 2 separately places hexagonal faceting beyond six monolayers. Missing fields: exact secondary-amine amount, all row batch labels. This operation groups source-described alternatives for navigation, not a single physical charge containing all alternatives simultaneously.
